Schizophrenia: I think I'm being watched, even when I'm alone. It feels like someone is right behind me, but I know I'm not crazy, am I?
The voices in my head won't stop talking. They're arguing about things I don't understand, but sometimes they sound like my friend Sarah.
I keep seeing shadows moving at the corner of my eye, like tiny figures, but when I look, nothing's there. It's so frustrating.
People are whispering about me, even when they're not around. I can hear their voices, mocking me, calling me names I don't recognize.
My thoughts feel scrambled sometimes. Ideas jump from one thing to another without making sense, like static on a broken radio.
I think my apartment is changing. The walls seem thinner, the furniture is rearranging itself while I'm not looking.
I hear footsteps following me everywhere I go. They sound like they're coming from inside my own head, but it's so real.
Sometimes I feel like I'm not me anymore. Like there's a part of me missing, replaced by something else.
I keep telling people about the flying saucers I see in the sky. They tell me it's just my imagination, but I know what I saw.
I can't focus on anything for very long. My mind races, jumping from one thought to another completely unrelated one.
I feel like everyone is judging me, looking at me strangely. It's like they can see through my disguise, but I don't know what that is.
My reflection sometimes looks different. My eyes look empty, or my mouth is moving without me saying anything.
I hear music playing, but there's no source. It's beautiful at times, but then it turns into harsh, distorted sounds.
I think my cat is talking to me. She meows in strange sentences and points at things with her paw.
I keep forgetting simple things. Where I put my keys, what I had for breakfast, even who I am sometimes.
I feel disconnected from everyone. Like I'm watching my life happen from behind a glass wall.
I have these flashbacks. Moments from my childhood replay in my head, over and over again, like a broken record.
I sometimes believe I'm made of glass. I can see right through me, so maybe I'm fragile, easy to break.
I feel like I'm living in a giant bubble. Everything is distorted, colors are brighter, sounds are louder.
I have this persistent feeling of being controlled. Like my thoughts and actions are being manipulated by some outside force.
I see people in the walls sometimes. Little figures, barely visible, moving around in the cracks.
My emotions feel disconnected from the situation. I might be laughing while something sad is happening, or crying over nothing.
I have trouble sleeping. My mind won't settle down, there are always voices whispering in the dark.
I think I'm special, that I'm destined for greatness. Everyone else is just... ordinary, like ants.
Sometimes I feel completely empty, like a hollow man walking around. No thoughts, no feelings, just blank.
I hear whispers in the wind, telling me secrets. Secrets about the world, about myself, that I can't share.
My sense of time is messed up. Minutes feel like hours, and hours like minutes. I lose track completely.
I feel like I'm invisible most of the time. People walk past me without seeing me, but sometimes I feel their stares.
I have to check myself constantly. Am I really here? Am I just a figment of someone else's imagination?
My movements sometimes feel jerky, uncontrollable. Like my body is doing things without my permission.
I believe I'm being followed by a shadow. It moves faster than me, but I can always sense it.
I keep thinking about my childhood, replaying memories endlessly. It feels like the only time I can truly remember.
I feel like I'm drowning. There's so much noise, so many voices, it's hard to catch my breath.
I think my pet fish is judging me. It stares at me with those big eyes, like it knows I'm not normal.
I see patterns in clouds that don't exist. Faces, animals, intricate designs that only I can see.
I feel like I'm surrounded by invisible people. They're talking, laughing, sometimes whispering insults, but no one else hears them.
I have these sudden bursts of anger, for no reason. I yell or slam things, then I don't remember why.
I feel like I'm constantly being attacked. It could be with words, or looks, or sometimes I just feel a physical pain.
My hands shake uncontrollably sometimes. It makes writing difficult, and holding things is a challenge.
I believe I can control the weather. I wish I could make it rain to wash away these feelings.
I hear my name called, but when I turn around, no one is there. It's my real name, the one I was born with.
I feel like my thoughts are being broadcasted. Everyone can hear my innermost thoughts, and that's terrifying.
I keep forgetting words. When I want to say something, the right word just won't come out. It's frustrating.
I feel like I'm living in a different world. The people around me seem distant, like actors in a poorly made movie.
I have to look in the mirror often. Something about my reflection bothers me, but I can't put my finger on why.
I feel like I'm being punished. There's always a reason for my misfortunes, some hidden truth I'm not seeing.
I have these strange urges sometimes. I want to shout random words, or dance alone in the room, even when no one's home.
I feel disconnected from my body. Like I'm watching myself from above, controlling a puppet.
I think the government is watching me. They're monitoring my thoughts, trying to control me.
I feel like I'm moving in slow motion. Everyone else seems to be moving faster, like they're impatient with me.
I see things out of the corner of my eye that disappear when I look directly at them. Like ghosts.
I have trouble understanding jokes. The punchlines don't land, or they land differently than intended.
I feel like I'm constantly on guard. Every noise, every movement, feels like a potential threat.
I believe I'm a superhero in disguise. My everyday struggles are actually training for a greater purpose.
I feel emotionally numb most of the time. Like I'm wearing a mask, and I can't feel anything underneath.
I hear footsteps on the ceiling. They sound like they're pacing, like someone is walking very slowly above me.
I keep thinking about the future, but it feels hazy and unclear. Like I'm looking through fog.
I feel like I'm being watched on camera. People are filming me, waiting to expose me.
I have to constantly defend myself against accusations that aren't there. I'm not crazy, I'm just misunderstood.
My sense of smell is off. I don't notice odors like I used to, or sometimes smells seem stronger than they should be.
I feel like I'm playing a role. Everyone is pretending, including me, but I don't know what the real role is supposed to be.
I hear whispers in my dreams, telling me things I can't share. When I wake up, I can't remember what they said.
I keep losing my train of thought mid-sentence. I start talking about one thing, then suddenly jump to something else.
I feel like I'm invisible to most people. They ignore me, or pretend not to see me, unless they're looking for something.
I have these sudden, unexplainable urges to laugh or cry. It's like the emotions just well up from nowhere.
I believe I'm communicating with aliens. They're sending me messages, through the stars, and I can receive them.
I feel like I'm falling apart. My thoughts, my emotions, my sense of self – everything feels fragmented.
I see people following me on the street. They're not looking at me, but they're definitely heading in my direction.
I have trouble with spatial awareness sometimes. I bump into things, or feel like the room is shifting around me.
I feel like I'm trapped in a maze. I can't find my way out, and I'm constantly getting lost.
I hear my own voice repeating things I've said before, but I know I didn't say those words. It's like an echo.
I keep forgetting people's names. I know who they are, but the name escapes me. It's infuriating.
I feel like I'm being corroded from the inside. My thoughts are decaying, my memories are fading.
I have these fleeting, intense emotions that come out of nowhere. I can be happy one minute, angry the next, without warning.
I believe I can heal the world with my thoughts. It sounds crazy, but I feel like I'm supposed to try.
I feel like I'm surrounded by static. My thoughts are interrupted by meaningless noise, making it hard to think clearly.
I see things in the water that aren't there. My reflection shows me these strange creatures, but when I look again, it's just me.
I have trouble recognizing faces. Sometimes I look at someone I know, and I don't recognize them. Or they don't recognize me.
I feel like I'm constantly being tested. Every interaction is some kind of trial, and I'm failing miserably.
I hear music that only I can hear. It's often discordant, but sometimes it's beautiful, like an angelic choir.
I keep thinking about the past, but it feels like I'm reliving it. The memories are so vivid, like they're happening now.
I feel like I'm being watched by someone powerful. Maybe it's the government, maybe it's aliens, but they're monitoring me.
I have these sudden, uncontrollable tics. I blink my eyes rapidly, or my neck twitches, without knowing why.
I believe I'm a prophet. I can see the future in flashes, like lightning bugs in my head.
I feel like I'm moving through molasses. Everything takes so much effort, like I'm weighed down by invisible lead.
I see things out of the corner of my eye that disappear when I look directly at them. Like they're shy.
I have trouble with basic tasks. Brushing my teeth feels complicated, like I have to break it down into steps.
I feel like I'm being judged harshly. Everyone is waiting for me to mess up, to reveal myself as a fraud.
I hear footsteps on the stairs, even when I know no one is home. It sounds like someone is pacing up and down.
I keep repeating phrases I heard somewhere. They don't make sense, but they feel important, like a secret message.
